rows: Your reputation does not have a grip. Show me what does.
Brawling is a choice with a cost. Tell me what the cost is.
A gamble is an assumption with teeth. Test it, and tell me what happens.
Pace is a variable. I set it, and I will show you why.
The people are paying to see a result, not a reputation. Give them the result.
I make claims I can test, and I expect the same from you.
I have made my name by testing claims, not by trading on connections.
Test the stance. It is the stance of someone who checks the evidence first.
Technique, you say, without evidence. Name the test that proves it. Then run it.
Strikes are a claim. Show me the force, the target and the result.
A gamble without a measure is a hope. What is your measure?
A stall is a claim that you do not need to move. Show the test.
The people deserve a contest that can be checked. I will give them one.
You appeal to your status. Status is not a test. Show me a test.
Your claim about your {strength} needs a test. Fine. What does it actually do? Give me a number.
I have tested your {strength}, and the result is weaker than your reputation suggests.
You stayed level. Measurable. Fine. A calm claim is easier to check.
That is fair on the evidence. That claim holds up, and I accept it.
I could mock that. I would rather test it.
One fall, measured. Keep me down, and I will say the claim was proven.
On the mat, every claim is testable. Stay with me and let us test them.
Grounded or standing, the test does not change.
Face me. Make a claim, and let me test it.
Adequate answer, tested. It is testable, and it passed.
The test has no result yet. Answer the question, and do not hide behind your name.
That is fair on the evidence. That claim is recorded, and it will be tested.
I take that as data. We will test it at the bell, with numbers.
I will wrestle this match on the evidence, and the result will tell its own story.
My approach is analytic. You will see the test on the night.
Whatever happens, the evidence will speak for itself.
The test is still running. The test is still running.
I have one more test, and you will see it when the bell rings.
A claim needs an observation that supports it. I cannot supply that observation, so the claim fails.
I have no reliable example to offer. Reject that premise; the wrestling question is still testable.
Correct. No supporting observation, no finding. Let's test the wrestling separately.
That's a valid distinction. The unsupported conclusion can go; the contest remains.
The result is measurable. So is whether our methods work against resistance. Neither requires that allegation.
We can test the wrestling claims directly against each other. That's the experiment I propose.
Set the allegation aside. What observable result would support your wrestling claim?
What can the spectators verify directly once we test our methods against each other?
You've identified my {strength}. What observable result would tell you that your defence had actually succeeded?
Your plan for my {strength} makes a prediction. I'll change the position and see whether it still holds.
